# Community Rule Column 2 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 2

---

**2:1** "May He bless you with all good and keep you from all evil;
**2:2** may He enlighten your heart with the insight of life and grace you with the knowledge of eternity;
**2:3** may He lift up His gracious countenance toward you for everlasting peace."
**2:4** And the Levites shall curse all the men of Belial's lot; they shall speak and say:
**2:5** "Cursed be you in all the works of your guilty wickedness! May God deliver you
**2:6** to terror at the hand of all who execute vengeance! May He bring destruction upon you
**2:7** at the hand of all who repay retribution! Cursed be you without mercy,
**2:8** according to the darkness of your deeds, and damned be you
**2:9** in the gloom of everlasting fire! May God not show you grace when you call, and may He not pardon you
**2:10** so as to atone for your iniquities! May He lift up His wrathful countenance in vengeance upon you, and may there be no
**2:11** peace for you by the word of those who hold fast to the fathers!" After the blessing and the cursing,
**2:12** all who enter the covenant shall say: "Amen, amen."
**2:13** The priests and the Levites shall continue and say: "Cursed be the one who enters
**2:14** this covenant while placing the stumbling blocks of his iniquities before himself, so as to backslide by them.
**2:15** When he hears the words of this covenant, he blesses himself in his heart, saying: 'I shall have peace,
**2:16** though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart.' But his spirit shall be swept away — the parched
**2:17** together with the watered — without forgiveness. The wrath of God and the zeal of His judgments
**2:18** shall burn against him unto everlasting destruction; and all the curses of this covenant shall cling
**2:19** to him, and God shall set him apart for evil, and he shall be cut off from the midst of all the Sons of Light,
**2:20** because of his backsliding from God through his idols and the stumbling block of his iniquity. He shall place his lot
**2:21** in the midst of the eternally accursed. And all who enter the covenant shall answer
**2:22** and say after them: "Amen, amen."
**2:23** Thus shall they do year by year throughout all the days of the dominion of Belial. The priests shall pass over
**2:24** first in order, according to their spirits, one after another; and the Levites shall pass over
**2:25** after them; and all the people shall pass over third in order, one after another, by thousands
**2:26** and hundreds and fifties and tens, so that every man of Israel may know his appointed place in the community of God for the eternal council. No man shall move down from his place nor move up from the position of his lot.

---
*LOGOS notes: The priestly blessing (2:1-3) echoes the Aaronic benediction (Num 6:24-26). The Levitical curse (2:5-10) systematically inverts each element of the blessing. The phrase "the parched together with the watered" (2:16-17) is a merism for totality (cf. Deut 29:18). "Spirits" in 2:24 refers to spiritual rank within the community. The ordering system in 2:23-26 establishes the annual review of communal hierarchy.*
